Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4665541. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to include canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
